modal.title: 📋 INFORMED VOLUNTARY CONSENT FORM
modal.subtitle: (Informed Consent)
modal.intro: This platform is an academically grounded educational technology project developed to analyze preschool children's cognitive, mathematical and social-emotional skills in a game-based environment. Your child's interactions on the platform are evaluated by an AI model in line with the indicators of the Turkish Ministry of National Education's "Türkiye Century Education Model (Maarif Model)".
modal.purposeIntro: Game data collected through the platform (completion time, number of errors, problem-solving strategies, etc.) will be used for the following purposes:
modal.purpose1: • Tracking the child's developmental progress and giving parents pedagogical feedback.
modal.purpose2: • Measuring the accuracy of the AI model's educational analysis.
modal.purpose3: • Using the resulting anonymous data as statistical data in scientific articles, conference papers and academic publications.
modal.anonText: Your child's real name and your contact details will never be used in academic publications. Data is reported with anonymous codes such as "Student A" or "44-month-old participant".
modal.protectText: Collected data is stored on secure cloud servers (Supabase) and is not shared with third parties for commercial purposes.
modal.voluntaryText: Participation in this study is entirely voluntary. You may delete your account and withdraw your consent to the use of your data at any time.
modal.consentText: This consent is entirely optional: if you leave the box unchecked, you can still use every feature of the platform exactly the same way. By checking the box, you declare that you have read the information above and agree to your data being used anonymously for academic research. You can withdraw your consent at any time.
modal.contactText: For any questions about the research process or how the data is used, you can contact the ChildhoodTech team and the researchers involved by email.
